fields.statusText: Pending (created 2026-11-14: four nonprofits (Alliance for Secure AI·Irreplaceable Education Fund·Public Citizen·Heat Initiative) filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court on 11/12 against Anthropic·Google·Meta·OpenAI·SpaceX AI affiliates under California unfair competition law — requesting restraining order to halt development of models stronger than current frontier (press report).
